item.title: Greetings from Syria, where time seems to melt as a glassmaker braves scorching temps
item.description: As a Syrian glassmaker created his wares in Damascus, watching his craft reminded this reporter to slow down and enjoy the moment.

item.title: How Ukrainians are coping with new, more deadly Russian attacks
item.description: Zanny Minton Beddoes, The Economist's editor in chief, just visited Ukraine. She says, despite all its drone weaponry, Kyiv is under extraordinary bombardment, as Russia tries to make it unlivable.
item.content:encoded: Zanny Minton Beddoes, The Economist's editor in chief, just visited Ukraine. She says, despite all its drone weaponry, Kyiv is under extraordinary bombardment, as Russia tries to make it unlivable.

item.title: A pilot stabs another pilot and tries to crash their flight to Tel Aviv, Israel says
item.description: As the plane went into a spin and began to plunge, a passenger and crew members got into the cockpit, subdued the pilot and diverted the flight to land in Saudi Arabia, Israel's leader says.

item.title: U.S. forces exit Iraq amid Iran war. And, SCOTUS revives Trump deportation policy
item.description: The U.S. has withdrawn its final troops from Iraq, leaving its defense future uncertain. And, the Supreme Court has sided for now with the Trump administration on third-country deportations.
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: Ammar Karim)

item.title: The U.S. military withdraws from Iraq over 2 decades after its invasion
item.description: 23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.
item.content:encoded:
23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.

(Image credit: Ahmad Al-Rubaye)
item.dc:creator: Jane Arraf

item.title: Retired general who led troops in Iraq warns U.S. exit may give Iran, ISIS an opening
item.description: Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, who commanded U.S. troops in Iraq, says the withdrawal could strengthen Iran and leave Iraq more vulnerable to ISIS.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: An 87-year-old woman whose eviction sparked protests in Spain is returning home

item.title: As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in
